about: One file per language: i18n/<code>.json, the same keys in each. en.json holds the English texts that the pages show; i18n.js replaces a text by the same key in the chosen language. Every catalog except English needs review by a native speaker (docs/handoff/round6/i18n.md lists the Preach My Gospel terms used).
